Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 📦.

JACK:
I don't want it! I don't need it! It's just a bunch of chemicals to control my mind 💥.

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you know the risks. You know it's the only way to manage your symptoms 🤕.

JACK:
I refuse! I won't take it! (stands up and starts to pace around the room) You don't understand me! You don't know what it's like to be me! 🌪️

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Jack, stop this. You're not listening to me 🗣️.

JACK:
(outraged) I'm listening! I'm listening to the voices in my head! And they're telling me to make you take the pills! 💬

DR. SMITH:
(skeptical) Jack, that's just your delusion. You're not really hearing voices 🎧.

JACK:
(defiantly) I am! And I'm telling you to take the pills! (points a shaking finger at Dr. Smith) You have to take them! You have to prove they're safe! 💊

Dr. Smith looks taken aback, but eventually nods and picks up the pills from his desk 📝. He approaches Jack, who is now standing in front of him, his eyes blazing with intensity 🔥.

DR. SMITH:
(hesitantly) Okay, Jack. I'll take the pills. But just to prove a point, okay? 🤔

Dr. Smith opens his mouth to swallow the pills, but as he does, Jack's body begins to fade away, like a ghost disappearing into thin air 👻.

DR. SMITH:
(confused) Wait... what's going on? 🤯

As Dr. Smith looks around, he realizes that Jack is no longer there. He's standing alone in the room, surrounded by the empty pill bottles and the echoes of his own sanity 😵.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) Oh no... oh no, no, no... 🙏

The camera zooms out, and we see that Dr. Smith is now standing in a hospital room, surrounded by the same pill bottles and the same echoes. But this time, he's the one who's been delusional all along 🤪.

FADE TO BLACK 🎬
